name: 10118194-0001LF
title: 10118194-0001LF: Micro USB type B receptacle, 5 contacts, right angle, surface mount with through-hole shell legs
summary: A right-angle Micro USB B receptacle that lies flat on the board with its opening at the board edge. Five contacts on a 0.65 mm pitch end in surface-mount tails along the rear; the stainless-steel shell has two rear pegs and two front legs that go into slots in the land pattern. It meets USB 2.0, is lead free, and withstands a 260 °C infrared reflow peak for 10 seconds.

operation.text: The five contact tails sit along the rear edge on surface pads. The shell has a pair of pegs at the rear, 5.00 mm apart on centres and 0.60 mm wide, and a pair of legs nearer the front, 0.90 mm deep, whose slots in the land pattern are 6.50 mm apart between inner edges; both pairs go into slots with pads. The board edge lies 1.45 mm in front of the centre line of the front legs.
Contact 1 and contact 5 are the two ends of the row; contacts 2 to 4 lie between them in order at 0.65 mm.
